title: Kimi moves to K2.5
summary:
Kimi gained image input and a larger context window; vision errors got clearer, and klein-large got a steadier footing.

The `kimi` endpoint now routes to Kimi K2.5, adding image input and a 256,000-token context window. New aliases include `kimi-k2.5`, `kimi-k2p5`, and `kimi-large`.

Failed image URLs in Claude and Gemini vision requests now return client errors instead of generic 500s, with clearer messages for missing images, access restrictions, oversized files, and other fetch failures.

Purchase options and payment methods are clearer, the beta-Pollen explanation includes examples, and API-key delete controls stay visible while the table scrolls.

highlights.title: Kimi gets image input
highlights.text: Send text and images to `kimi`, now backed by Kimi K2.5 with a 256,000-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi).
